description: CR 612.1 whole cards: the rewritten affected sets decide a real combat phase
note: Kormus Bell animates alice's Swamp into a 1/1, and the printed Synthetic Wetland Frenzy requires Swamps to attack each combat if able. alice tries to declare no attackers; CR 508.1d rejects that whole, so the Swamp attacks an empty board and bob goes to 19. Synthetic because no printing names a basic land type as the subject of a combat requirement. The hacked file is the same board with Swamp swapped for Forest on the Frenzy.
